title: Getting Started with Template Builder
author: System Administrator
overview: Learn how to create custom templates using the visual Template Builder. This guide covers dragging assets, configuring fields, adding sections, and saving templates for reuse across your organization.
prerequisites: Access to the CMS Admin panel
Familiarity with the content types in your organization

steps.title: Step 1: Open Template Builder
steps.description: Navigate to the CMS Admin panel and click the 'Template Builder' button in the top navigation.

steps.title: Step 2: Add Sections
steps.description: Click '+ Add Section' to create a new content section. Give it a descriptive name like 'Key Metrics' or 'Project Updates'.

steps.title: Step 3: Drag Assets
steps.description: Browse the Asset Library on the left. Drag assets like 'Card List', 'Text Input', or 'Bar Chart' into your section.

steps.title: Step 4: Configure Properties
steps.description: Select a field to edit its properties in the right sidebar. Set the field key (JSON property name), label, and example data.

steps.title: Step 5: Test Template
steps.description: Click the 'Test' button to preview how the template will look in the editor. Make adjustments as needed.

steps.title: Step 6: Save Template
steps.description: Click 'Save Template', enter a name and description, and the system will validate your template before saving.

keyPoints: Field keys become JSON property names - use camelCase
Chart assets require chartConfig to specify labels and colors
All templates must include the Standard Header section
Test your template before using it to create content

importantNote: Always test your templates before using them in production. The validation system will catch structural issues, but testing ensures the user experience is optimal.

troubleshooting.issue: Template validation fails with 'Generic section names' error
troubleshooting.solution: Rename any sections called 'Section 2' or 'Section 3' to descriptive names like 'Metrics', 'Updates', or 'KPIs'. The inline warning badge on each section header will guide you.

troubleshooting.issue: Charts show 'Value' on x-axis instead of data labels
troubleshooting.solution: Ensure the chartConfig includes xAxisKey set to the correct field name (usually 'name'). The Properties tab lets you edit chart data directly.

faqs.question: Can I edit templates after saving them?
faqs.answer: Yes! Load the template in Template Builder, make your changes, and save again. Existing content created from the template won't be affected.

faqs.question: What asset types are available?
faqs.answer: The Asset Library includes: Basic Inputs (text, textarea, number, date), Lists & Arrays (simple list, card list), Complex (object, key-value), Rich Content (markdown, expression, code block, quote), and Charts (pie, bar, line, radial).

faqs.question: How do I create multi-field grids?
faqs.answer: Add multiple assets to the same section. The Template Builder automatically creates indexed keys (section_0, section_1) and EditorModalV2 renders them in a CSS grid layout.
